title: P-3: both gateways register in one process — routes.js becomes a barrel, routes-live-animals.js gains the set-context wiring, co-residency.test.js is born
recipe: SIBLING-SET-PLAN.md §4.1 / §4.4 / §4.5 + §5 P-3, all as REVISED 2026-08-01 by ruling R3 (co-residency). FD-1/FD-2 are REVISED: there is no served-set env var and routes.js is a BARREL, not a selector. No recipe doc exists yet (docs/add-a-set.md is pp-053, which lands after this increment and describes the shape this increment creates) — the plan sections are the script.

filesToTouch.what: The current src/server/app/routes.js body (lines 1-77) MOVED here, then given the co-residency wiring. It sits in the same directory so every relative './…' specifier resolves unchanged. Still exports `liveAnimals`; plugin name stays 'live-animals'. Changes to the register body, in the LOAD-BEARING order of §4.4.3 (context → mount → config → assertions → dispatch → persistence → cookies → guard → priming → routes): (0) call `registerSetMount('live-animals', '/live-animals')` (R7 — symmetric mounts; registerSetMount THROWS on an empty prefix, and pp-057 already made this mount real) and install the realm-scoped context extension `server.ext('onPreAuth', (request, h) => { enterSetContext('live-animals'); return h.continue })` as the FIRST things in the body, and wrap the WHOLE remainder in `await withSetContext('live-animals', async () => { … })` so the boot-time reads (assertObligationPurity, assertFulfilmentBindingCoverage, buildDispatch) resolve this set; (1-9) add `'live-animals'` as the FIRST argument to every configure*/build* call that pp-056 keyed — configureObligationSet, configureFulfilmentRegistry, configureCommodityReference, configureJourneyFlow, buildDispatch, configureRecords, configureSession; (10) `registerJourneyCookie(server, { base: '/live-animals', cookieNames: SESSION_COOKIE_NAMES })` — carried through from pp-057, which already moved the cookie path off '/'; (11) the existing onPreHandler entry-guard extension unchanged (already realm-scoped — the proven precedent for FD-15); (12) countries.prime()/ports.prime() unchanged and still guarded by isRealMode(). NO URL change AT THIS INCREMENT (pp-057 already migrated live-animals to /live-animals; this increment must not move it again) and no behavioural change. Import registerSetMount/enterSetContext/withSetContext from './shared/set-context.js'. Do not add migration comments — git history is the record.

Full rewrite as a BARREL (FD-2 as revised). At this increment it is one line: `export { liveAnimals } from './routes-live-animals.js'`. pp-007 adds the second line `export { plantProducts } from './routes-plant-products.js'` when that file exists. There is NO selector, NO SETS map, NO servedSet()/servedSetName(), and NO read of process.env anywhere in this file — a served-set env var is exactly what ruling R3 deleted. routes.js keeps its dep-cruiser routes-is-the-gateway allowlist entry even though a barrel no longer imports sets/** directly (removing it would be an unrelated semantic change — P-4/pp-010).

REWRITTEN FOR R7. Lines 7 and 20-26 are already in their R7 shape — pp-057 rewrote them: `import { liveAnimals } from './app/routes.js'` (the barrel now supplies it); `await server.register(liveAnimals, { routes: { prefix: '/live-animals' } })` as its OWN call; `if (authEnabled) await server.register([signout])` as a SEPARATE UNPREFIXED call (FD-19); and the server-wide `GET /` → 302 `DEFAULT_SET_BASE` route (FD-18). This increment's job here is to VERIFY all four survived the gateway split intact and to leave them alone — in particular the barrel swap must not tempt anyone to re-collapse the two register calls into one array, which would re-break /signout. The SECOND set registration — `await server.register(plantProducts, { routes: { prefix: '/plant-products' } })`, again its own call because `routes.prefix` applies to a whole call — is added by pp-007, which is the increment that creates the plant gateway. Touch nothing else. If the diff here is empty, say so in the increment log rather than inventing a change; an empty diff is the expected outcome.

Minimal slice of P-4 pulled forward because this increment's own ladder runs lint:arch and routes-live-animals.js imports sets/live-animals/**. `routes-is-the-gateway` rule (line 31): the `from.pathNot` array (currently exactly [`^${APP}/sets/`, `^${APP}/routes\\.js$`, '\\.test\\.js$']) gains `` `^${APP}/routes-live-animals\\.js$` ``. Do NOT add routes-plant-products.js (its file does not exist yet — pp-007/pp-010) and do NOT touch the sets-not-l1 rule (pp-010's P-4 owns the widening to `^${APP}/(routes|routes-live-animals|routes-plant-products|obligation-purity)\\.js$`). shared/set-context.js needs NO rule change — it is ordinary L2 importing nothing under sets/. Do NOT regenerate .dependency-cruiser-known-violations.json (baseline discipline).

THE standing co-residency evidence file (T-9). Created here with the LIVE-ANIMALS HALF ONLY; pp-007 adds the plant half, and every later platform increment extends it when it adds a seam. It must never be folded into another file — it is the one test that can fail for 'co-residency broke' and nothing else. At this increment it boots ONE @hapi/hapi server through the real router shape, registers `liveAnimals` UNDER ITS PREFIX (`{ routes: { prefix: '/live-animals' } }`), and asserts: (a) GET '/live-animals' — NOT '/' (R7: no set owns the root) — returns 200 with live-animals dashboard content; (a2) THE THREE ROOTLESS-SERVER CASES, which exist only because no set owns '/' and which nothing else in the suite covers: GET '/' returns a 302 to '/live-animals' (FD-18 — assert 302, not 301, and assert the location matches DEFAULT_SET_BASE), GET '/signout' RESOLVES rather than 404ing (FD-19 — this is the only assertion that catches signout having been left inside the prefixed register array, because it registers fine at the wrong path), and GET `${config.get('assetPath')}/<asset>` resolves unprefixed (a prefixed static-asset registration would 404 every stylesheet silently); (b) the request resolved the live-animals set — assert through observable behaviour, e.g. a page whose rendering depends on the live-animals manifest/journey flow, plus the liveAnimals* cookie names on the response; (c) REALM-SCOPING PIN (§4.1 risk 1, load-bearing) — register a second trivial plugin owning a route OUTSIDE the live-animals realm and prove the live-animals onPreHandler entry guard does NOT run for it, which is the mechanism pp-007's cross-set version depends on; (d) ALS-INTERLEAVING PIN (§4.1 risk 2) — two concurrent injections, the first deliberately awaiting inside its handler, both still resolving their own set context (at this increment both are live-animals, so the pin is structural; pp-007 upgrades it to a genuine cross-set pair); (e) the four accessors from pp-005 read the live-animals policy under this context. Structure the file so pp-007 adds cases rather than rewrites it: a shared `bootServer({ sets })` helper taking the gateways to register.

The existing 'promoted live-animals route authentication' describe imports allRoutes from the set directly and is unaffected by the barrel — leave it untouched. DELETE nothing else and ADD no selector tests: there is no selector, no SERVED_SET and no unknown-set error to pin (the round-1 plan of this increment specified exactly those three cases; ruling R3 removes them). If a `grep -rn 'SERVED_SET'` in this file finds anything, it is a leftover and must go.

specs: src/server/app/co-residency.test.js (Vitest) — one booted server; live-animals half: dashboard renders, set resolved from the plugin realm, realm-scoping pin, ALS-interleaving pin, per-set policy read. Extended with the plant half by pp-007 and by every later platform increment that adds a seam.
NO Playwright spec — zero UI/behaviour change; the existing features + journeys suites are the regression net and both run in the ladder
acceptanceCriteria: src/server/app/routes-live-animals.js exports `liveAnimals` and the git diff reads as a pure move PLUS exactly the §4.4.2 additions: registerSetMount('live-animals','/live-animals'), the realm-scoped onPreAuth enterSetContext extension, the withSetContext('live-animals', …) wrapper around the register body, setId as the first argument of all seven configure*/buildDispatch calls, and registerJourneyCookie(server, { base: '/live-animals', cookieNames: SESSION_COOKIE_NAMES }). Nothing else inside the plugin body changes.
src/server/app/routes.js is a barrel — one re-export line at this increment. It contains no env read, no SETS map and no selector functions.

`grep -rn 'SERVED_SET' .` across the whole repo returns EMPTY. No served-set env var exists anywhere: not in src/, not in package.json scripts, not in playwright.config.js, not in CI config, not in docs.

Live-animals URLs are byte-identical TO THE POST-pp-057 STATE — i.e. everything is served under /live-animals and the journey cookie path is /live-animals. This increment moves NO URL: it is a gateway-file split, not a mount change. Every URL assertion in the repo (all of them migrated by pp-057) passes unedited HERE, and that is a meaningful bar for THIS increment precisely because pp-057 already did the migration.
GET / returns a 302 (not a 301) to /live-animals, sourced from the single DEFAULT_SET_BASE constant (FD-18) — asserted in co-residency.test.js.

GET /signout RESOLVES at its unprefixed path with live-animals registered under a prefix (FD-19) — asserted in co-residency.test.js. This assertion exists because signout registers successfully at the WRONG path if it is left inside the prefixed register array, so nothing else fails.
GET ${config.get('assetPath')}/<asset> and GET /health resolve at their unprefixed paths (FD-19 same check, applied and cleared for both) — asserted in co-residency.test.js.

src/server/router.js is UNCHANGED by this increment (pp-057 already put it in the R7 shape: one prefixed register per set, signout hoisted, the / redirect). The two register calls are NOT re-collapsed into one array.

REALM-SCOPING PIN is green: a route outside the live-animals plugin realm does not execute the live-animals entry guard. (pp-007 upgrades this to the cross-set form — a plant route must not run the live-animals guard.)

ALS-INTERLEAVING PIN is green: two concurrent in-flight requests, the slower awaiting inside its handler, each still read their own set context. If this fails, STOP — the contingency (explicit setId threading via request.app plus signature changes) is a materially larger increment that must be re-planned, not improvised.
co-residency.test.js exists at src/server/app/co-residency.test.js with a bootServer({ sets }) helper that pp-007 can extend by adding cases, not by rewriting.
routes.test.js keeps its existing route-authentication describe unchanged and gains NO selector tests.

npm run lint (incl. lint:arch) green with routes-live-animals.js in place; .dependency-cruiser-known-violations.json byte-identical; the routes-is-the-gateway pathNot addition is the only dep-cruiser change.
Whole existing ladder green with NO spec edits and NO new env vars: npm run test:live-animals, npm test, PORT=3050 npm run test:features, PORT=3050 npm run test:e2e.
No files change beyond the six listed; in particular no file under sets/ is edited by this increment.

notes:
AMENDED FOR RULING R7 (Sam, 2026-08-01, later session) — SYMMETRIC MOUNTS, FD-16 reversed. The round-2 claim that 'router.js registers live-animals exactly as today' is RETIRED: by the time this increment runs, pp-057 has already mounted live-animals under /live-animals, hoisted /signout out of the prefixed register (FD-19) and added the server-wide `GET /` → 302 `/live-animals` (FD-18). So router.js:7,20-26 is a VERIFY-not-edit surface here, routes-live-animals.js passes registerSetMount('live-animals','/live-animals') and registerJourneyCookie(server, { base: '/live-animals', … }), and co-residency.test.js is born asserting `GET /live-animals` for the live-animals half rather than `GET /`. THREE ASSERTIONS EXIST ONLY BECAUSE NO SET OWNS THE ROOT and they are added here: the / redirect, /signout resolving, and the static-asset route resolving. The last two are the ones that fail SILENTLY otherwise — a route registered at the wrong path registers perfectly well. routes.test.js is expected unchanged (route shapes are prefix-free) — VERIFY, do not assume.

AMENDED 2026-08-01 for Sam's ruling R3 (co-residency) — RETITLED AND RESCOPED, which is a genuine scope change, not a wording tidy. The round-1 increment built a boot-time SERVED_SET selector: routes.js held a SETS map, servedSetName()/servedSet() read process.env lazily, router.js registered [servedSet()], and routes.test.js pinned three selector cases including an unknown-value throw. ALL of that is deleted by the reversal. There is no selector, no SETS map, no env var and no unknown-set error. routes.js becomes a two-line barrel (one line until pp-007 lands the plant gateway); the real gateway is routes-live-animals.js, which gains the set-context wiring; and the process serves both sets simultaneously rather than choosing one. NEW DEPENDENCIES: pp-056 (P-9 — the seams must be keyed by set before two sets can register) and pp-057 (P-10 — URLs must be namespaced before two sets can both claim /notifications/…). ID CONVENTION for the reversal's four new increments: pp-056 = P-9 set-context module + per-set seam keying; pp-057 = P-10 per-set URL namespace; pp-058 = P-11 setId-first tripwire; pp-053 = G-A/R6 docs/add-a-set.md. PHASING DECISION (headless — the plan's §4.4 end-state vs §9's ordering): §4.4 describes the finished shape (barrel exports both, router registers both), but §9 puts P-3 in phase m0-a with live-animals as the only set and the plant gateway in m0-b. Importing or registering a routes-plant-products.js that does not exist is impossible and a stub placeholder would be dead code, so this increment lands the live-animals half of the end-state and pp-007 adds the barrel's second export plus router.js's separate prefixed register call. Both halves are named in pp-007's filesToTouch so nothing is orphaned. The same split applies to co-residency.test.js: born here with the live-animals half and a bootServer({ sets }) seam, completed by pp-007. TWO RISKS THIS INCREMENT MUST RETIRE, NOT ASSUME (§4.1): realm scoping is real (Hapi scopes request-lifecycle extensions added inside a plugin to that plugin's routes — the live-animals entry guard is ALREADY a realm-scoped onPreHandler at routes.js:65-68, so the mechanism is proven in this codebase and onPreAuth simply runs earlier in the same lifecycle), and enterWith survives interleaving. Both get pins here in structural form and cross-set form at pp-007; a red interleaving pin is a STOP-and-replan, not a patch. Also handed over from pp-005: co-residency.test.js gains the assertion that the two sets read DIFFERENT enforcedAtContinue values in one process — the case lands with the plant half at pp-007, and pp-005 already proves the same divergence at unit level. Two-sided verification rule (REVISED, R3): 'both sets serve correctly from the SAME running process' is the standing bar, but it cannot be fully exercised until pp-007 registers the second gateway; the bar HERE is that live-animals is provably unchanged BY THIS INCREMENT (no URL moves on top of pp-057's migration, no spec edits, no env vars) and that the co-residency mechanism itself is pinned. Exemplar files to read before writing: src/server/app/routes.js:1-77 (the body being moved, incl. the 13 wiring calls at 47-73 and the entry-guard ext at 65-68), src/server/router.js:7,20,26, .dependency-cruiser.cjs:25-34, src/server/app/routes.test.js:1-13, and pp-056's shared/set-context.js as landed.
openQuestions: ~10 markdown docs (src/server/app/docs/{architecture,README,persistence,decisions}.md + sets/live-animals/docs/*.md) describe routes.js as the sole gateway/composition point; after the barrel split that role belongs to routes-<set>.js. The doc sweep is NOT in this increment — pp-053 (G-A/R6) authors docs/add-a-set.md with the correct picture and is the natural home for reconciling the neighbouring docs. Decide there, not here.

pp-056/pp-057/pp-058/pp-053 are working ids for the reversal's four new increments (P-9, P-10, P-11, G-A). If the backlog assigns different ids, sweep the dependsOn arrays of pp-005, pp-006, pp-007, pp-009 and pp-010.
